SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0

SELECT s.cname,
       sc.sname,
       sc.AvgScrWrite,
       sch.CharterNum,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank
FROM satscores AS sc
JOIN schools AS sch ON sc.cds = sch.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sc.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sch.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rank

SELECT f.`School Name`,
       COALESCE(s.Street, '') || ', ' || COALESCE(s.City, '') || ', ' || COALESCE(s.State, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(s.Zip, '') AS full_street_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T2.NumGE1500 >= 1500

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       ss.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score,
       s.Phone AS communication_number
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31'
   OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'

WITH local_diff AS (
    SELECT s.School AS school_name,
           s.DOCType AS doc_type,
           (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Local'
)
SELECT school_name, doc_type
FROM local_diff
WHERE diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM local_diff)

SELECT `School Name`,
       `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.County,
           sat.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 12 AS monthly_avg_schools_opened_1980
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT
    `School Name`,
    `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND `High Grade` = '9'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange'
  AND StatusType = 'Merged'

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 0
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'

SELECT f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, f.`District Code`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine'

SELECT s.City,
       COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_provision_schools
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1

GROUP BY s.City

SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
ORDER BY COUNT(r.uuid) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT l.status
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'

  AND l.format = 'vintage'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM foreign_data

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS banned_white_border_cards
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE (power IS NULL OR power = '*')

        FROM cards
        WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1

SELECT DISTINCT T2.type
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T2.language = 'German'

FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code

FROM cards c

FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code

AND NOT EXISTS (

FROM cards c

SELECT u.DisplayName

SELECT u.DisplayName

SELECT SUM(u.UpVotes) * 1.0 / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_upvotes,

FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*))
  - (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS PercentageDifference
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Student'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio

SELECT u.DisplayName,
       SUM(p.ViewCount) AS TotalViews
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY u.DisplayName
ORDER BY TotalViews DESC

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

FROM users u
WHERE u.Views >= 1000

      FROM postHistory ph

  AND NOT EXISTS (

      FROM postHistory ph2

FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

FROM postLinks pl
JOIN posts p ON pl.PostId = p.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', pl.CreationDate) = '2010'

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS FirstVoteDate
FROM votes AS v
JOIN users AS u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Id, p.Title
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN tags t ON p.Tags LIKE '%<' || t.TagName || '>%'
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
    SELECT u.Id
    FROM users u
    JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom'
    GROUP BY u.Id
    HAVING SUM(p.FavoriteCount) >= 4
) AS uk_users

SELECT p.Id AS PostId,
       COALESCE(u.DisplayName, p.OwnerDisplayName) AS OwnerDisplayName
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

SELECT p.ViewCount AS TotalViews,
       u.DisplayName AS UserName
FROM postHistory ph
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
WHERE ph.Text = 'Computer Game Datasets'
ORDER BY ph.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)'

WITH banned_counts AS (
    SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_total
    FROM legalities
    WHERE status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY format
),
top_format AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM banned_counts
    ORDER BY banned_total DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities l
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = (SELECT format FROM top_format)

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS zero_score_comments
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CommentCount = 1
  AND c.Score = 0

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM customers

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

SELECT y.CustomerID
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY y.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT substr(y.Date, 5, 2) AS month,
       SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY substr(y.Date, 5, 2)
ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 6
  AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM pct)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201202'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS more_sme_czk_than_eur
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

SELECT DISTINCT c.Currency
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24'

SELECT c.Segment
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cze_transactions
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
  AND g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND t.Price = 548.4

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS PremiumPercentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK'

WITH cust AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
    LIMIT 1
),
c2012 AS (
    SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS cons
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM cust)
      AND Date LIKE '2012%'
),
c2013 AS (
    SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS cons
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM cust)
      AND Date LIKE '2013%'
)
SELECT (c2012.cons - c2013.cons) / c2012.cons AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM c2012, c2013

SELECT
    t.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) AS total_spent,
    SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT team_api_id, MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes

ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name,

WITH last_race AS (

),
champs AS (
    SELECT lr.year, ds.driverId
    FROM last_race lr
    JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = lr.raceId AND ds.position = 1
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT
        c.year,
        CAST(substr(r.time, 1, instr(r.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
        + CAST(substr(substr(r.time, instr(r.time, ':') + 1), 1,
                      instr(substr(r.time, instr(r.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
        + CAST(substr(substr(r.time, instr(r.time, ':') + 1),
                      instr(substr(r.time, instr(r.time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
    FROM champs c
    JOIN results r ON r.driverId = c.driverId
    JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId AND ra.year = c.year
    WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
      AND r.time LIKE '%:%:%'
)

FROM parsed
WHERE year < 1975
